SecretArn.description: The ARN of the Secrets Manager secret used for transit encryption.

DestinationAddress.description: The destination IP address for the SRT protocol in caller mode.

DestinationPort.description: The destination port number for the SRT protocol in caller mode.

MinimumLatencyMilliseconds.description: The minimum latency in milliseconds for the SRT protocol in caller mode.

StreamId.description: The stream ID for the SRT protocol in caller mode.

MinimumLatencyMilliseconds.description: The minimum latency in milliseconds for the SRT protocol in listener mode.

Port.description: The port number for the SRT protocol in listener mode.

NetworkInterfaceArn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the network interface associated with the standard router output.

AvailabilityZone.description: The Availability Zone where you want to create the router output. This must be a valid Availability Zone for the region specified by regionName, or the current region if no regionName is provided.

CreatedAt.description: The timestamp when the router output was created.

Id.description: The unique identifier of the router output.

IpAddress.description: The IP address of the router output.

MaximumBitrate.description: The maximum bitrate for the router output.

Name.description: The name of the router output.

RegionName.description: The Amazon Web Services Region for the router output. Defaults to the current region if not specified.

Tags.description: Key-value pairs that can be used to tag this router output.

UpdatedAt.description: The timestamp when the router output was last updated.
